contract.module_homes: alternating CUDA homes from cuda:0 by stable graph path
contract.active_context_policy: Niagara placement before external activation; CPU parameter homes preserve direct upstream assertions
contract.non_torch_policy: Reject non-Torch numerical forwarding; structural backend-switch checks retain the public Caskade API
contract.synthetic_common_root: temporary ownership only; all links removed after call
contract.pointer_module_dependencies: co-located with parameters at default home
contract.true_split_definition: one call observes both GPUs and positive inter-GPU transfers
